metadata.description: Isolated fictional two-parcel development scenario, not the 24-parcel map dataset.
metadata.execution: Pure schema/policy examples only; no calls, signatures, approvals, transfers or database mutations executed.
metadata.compatibility: OwnerHandoff v1 is a separate contract; it is not the legacy API v1 Snapshot or map envelope version.
metadata.money: USD integer cents; contract tranche=floor(compensationCents/5), balance=exact remainder. Monthly fees are separate.
metadata.contact: References and consent flags are invented. They are not real registrations or consent evidence.
metadata.dates: Illustrative demo-clock dates, not operational deadlines.

negativeCases.description: A selected route and call consent do not imply landowner acceptance.
A counteroffer is not an accepted agreement.
An unclear model result remains review-required.
A refused parcel cannot enter the agreement-ready package.
A failed simulation check must not yield an agreement-ready route.
Even explicitly accepted terms must remain within the authorized owner cap.
Construction, compensation and the common rent horizon must fit the project budget.
Rounded map rent equivalents cannot silently become exact accepted terms.
An owner requires an explicit mock payout destination.
A payout recipient must belong to the same owner.
Old route evidence is rejected against the current server state.
Accepted terms must have the current per-parcel version.
A result from the previous session cannot change a new demo.
Every current route contract needs its simulated signature.
Signatures alone do not provide operator approval.
Approval must bind the current route version.
Regenerated contracts require a new matching approval.
The approved contract recipient must match the owner fixture.
The balance cannot be planned before an explicit completion event.
The initial 20% must be settled before the remaining compensation.
The first full monthly fee is due one calendar month after completion.
No monthly fee can accrue/pay without completion.
Changing a request key does not create another business obligation.
Regenerating a contract cannot create another payment for the same session/parcel/stage.
Settled IDs alone cannot prove the correct tranche was paid.
Changing approved compensation after an initial payment requires an explicit adjustment workflow; it cannot recompute an unrelated 80% balance.
Moving completion after payments must not create a new rental period or another obligation.
Settled balances and rent bind the original completion event.
Extending the rent horizon after settlement requires a separately approved adjustment; it cannot create an extra month silently.

reasons: Every evaluated route failed at least one simulation/cap/budget check.

adapterScenarios.limitation: These response/lifecycle sketches are adapter acceptance expectations, not implemented routing, server persistence or provider behavior.
